name: Internet II
attribution: Converted from deathrun_internet.bsp (the second stage) by tuomas (https://gamebanana.com/mods/127024, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as listed there). Geometry only: boxes and traps rebuilt from the map's brushes and entities, none of the author's textures, models or sounds. Shipped on the strength of credit and removal on request: tell the repository owner and the map is taken out.
blurb: The second corridor of the space and internet run: the same straight dash, four traps worked from the walkway beside it.
